```{.r .cell-code}
# Load and clean up the food category table
food_category <- food_categoryc %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%    
  rename(food_category_description = description)

# Macro nutrient IDs we care about
macro_ids <- c(
  energy  = 1008,
  protein = 1003,
  carbs   = 1005,
  fat     = 1004)

# Pull only macro nutrients from nutrient table
macro_nutrients <- nutrient %>%
  filter(id %in% macro_ids) %>% 
  transmute(
    nutrient_id   = id,
    nutrient_name = name,
    unit_name)

# Join food with category and branded info
food_full <- food %>%
  left_join(food_category, by = c("food_category_id" = "id")) %>% 
  left_join(branded_food, by = "fdc_id")  

# Join portion table with measure units
portion_full <- food_portion %>%
  left_join(measure_unit, by = c("measure_unit_id" = "id")) %>% 
  rename(portion_unit = name)

# Pick a default portion for each food (smallest seq_num)
portion_default <- portion_full %>%
  group_by(fdc_id) %>%
  slice_min(seq_num, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get only macro nutrients per food and attach labels + portions
food_macros_long <- food_nutrient %>%
  filter(nutrient_id %in% macro_ids) %>%         
  left_join(macro_nutrients, by = "nutrient_id") %>%
  left_join(food_full,       by = "fdc_id") %>%
  left_join(portion_default, by = "fdc_id")

# Clean nutrient names so they pivot nicely later
food_macros_long <- food_macros_long %>%
  mutate(
    nutrient_short = case_when(
      nutrient_name == "Energy" ~ "kcal",
      nutrient_name == "Protein" ~ "protein_g",
      nutrient_name == "Carbohydrate, by difference" ~ "carb_g",
      nutrient_name == "Total lipid (fat)" ~ "fat_g",
      TRUE ~ nutrient_name))

# Aggregate macro values across foods + their default portion info
food_macros_agg <- food_macros_long %>%
  group_by(
    fdc_id,
    food_name                  = description,
    data_type,
    food_category_code         = code,
    food_category              = food_category_description,
    brand_owner,
    brand_name,
    serving_size,
    serving_size_unit,
    household_serving_fulltext,
    default_portion_descr      = portion_description,
    default_portion_grams      = gram_weight,
    portion_unit,
    nutrient_short
    ) %>%
  summarise(
    amount = mean(amount.x, na.rm = TRUE),  
    .groups = "drop")

# Convert long 
nutrition_master_macros <- food_macros_agg %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = nutrient_short,
    values_from = amount)

nutrition_master_macros <- nutrition_master_macros %>%
  # keep only foods that have macros AND a portion gram weight
  filter(
    !is.na(kcal),
    !is.na(protein_g),
    !is.na(carb_g),
    !is.na(fat_g),
    !is.na(default_portion_grams),
    default_portion_grams > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    kcal_per_portion  = kcal * default_portion_grams / 100,
    protein_g_per_portion = protein_g * default_portion_grams / 100,
    carb_g_per_portion  = carb_g * default_portion_grams / 100,
    fat_g_per_portion = fat_g * default_portion_grams / 100
  ) %>%
  select(
    fdc_id,
    food_name,
    data_type,
    food_category,
    brand_owner,
    brand_name,
    default_portion_descr,
    default_portion_grams,
    portion_unit,
    kcal_per_portion,
    protein_g_per_portion,
    carb_g_per_portion,
    fat_g_per_portion)
```
